title: Surreal Dreamscape Reflection
description: A young woman with blue-tipped hair sits pensively in the foreground beside a glowing river containing orange koi and a reflection of an armored knight. In the surreal sky, two green planets hang above a desert dune where a red-cloaked figure walks, while an ornate circular frame reveals a knight in purple armor standing between two golden pillars amid a floral wreath.
prompt: A contemplative young woman with long dark hair featuring bright blue streaks sits in the lower left, resting her chin on her hand beside a magical river. The river contains orange koi fish and clearly reflects a knight in purple armor. In the background, a desert dune rises under a dramatic sky with two glowing green planets, a red robed figure walking, and a large ornate circular frame decorated with flowers, seashells and bones that contains another view of the knight between two golden columns. A green staircase ascends into clouds on the right. Highly detailed fantasy surrealism with cosmic and mystical elements.
